title: Repair a search
prompt: Return every name that can be reached from start by following connections, including start itself, in the order a breadth-first search first finds them. Visit a name's neighbours in the order they are listed.
hints: Which places in the failing check are more than one step from the start?
Each name that is found has neighbours of its own to look at. A queue holds the names still to be explored.
Keep a Set of seen names and a queue starting with start. For each name in the queue, add every unseen neighbour to both.
checkLabels: From home, the search finds shop, park, school and library, in that order.
A name with no connections reaches only itself.
A search stays inside its own group.
A one-way connection is followed forwards only.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Stops after the direct neighbours of the start.
Explores the newest name first, which is a depth-first order.

feedback: Write the queue out by hand for the first check. Each name is explored in the order it was added, oldest first.
